unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning open-source LLMs on institutional radiology reports for summarization
Comparing multiple fine-tuned LLMs with automated text metrics (ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore, BLEU) plus radiologist review of correctness and completeness

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares seven fine-tuned open-source LLMs on summarizing radiology reports and extracting clinical outcomes, using retrospective report datasets and human clinician qualitative grading, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
